status: Protocol saved before these repeated-split outcomes; all data remain the previously explored source, not an external or confirmatory cohort.
outer_selection: Among label-only stratified-group candidates choose lexicographically fewest missing test classes, then lowest squared class-proportion imbalance; save candidates and final assignments before fitting. No descriptors, predictions or errors enter split selection.
frame_policy: Identical deduplicated input pool and up-to-12 frames; nested temporal 1/3/6/12 depth descriptors from experiment28, frozen DINOv2; no reprocessing choices based on errors.
teacher_crossfit: Exclude the held training animal from fitting AND reselect teacher SVR hyperparameters on the unchanged inner-validation animals after exclusion. Frozen full-training-selected parameter identities are a separate ablation.
gate_selection: Mean inner-validation MAE at caps .25/.5/.75; no outer test selection
primary_endpoint: For each repeat, average pooled-event MAE at .25/.5/.75 caps. Repeats summarised without choosing a best seed.
statistics: Average paired episode errors across repeats first; 10000 fixed-model animal-cluster bootstrap resamples; repeats and folds are not independent biological replicates.
static_baselines: Fixed-depth and full-RGBD baselines always report actual resource cost. Mark infeasible comparisons explicitly when their fixed cost exceeds a stated cap; do not silently claim budget feasibility.
stop_rule: Retain all 3 seeds and all methods; do not add repeats or choose a new primary method after looking at outcomes. If the proposed method is unstable, report this as exploratory evidence rather than claiming a confirmed advance.
